blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — More than 90,000 senior citizens here can claim their quarterly financial assistance from December 10 to 12, 2026, as the city government sets its final distribution schedule for the year. Mayor Nestor Archival announced the three-day payout in a public advisory, urging qualified beneficiaries to prepare the necessary identification and documents […]...
